Guarantee credit from 12.04.21

Standard minimum guarantee (see DMG 77331)
47 Amount of SMG from 12.04.21


1. Claimant who has no partner £177.10


2. Claimant and one partner (if appropriate) £270.30


3. Each additional spouse in a polygamous marriage case £93.20


4. Prisoners Nil


5. Members of religious orders fully maintained by their order Nil
